baseline.rule: The served V5 is the executable Golden Master for observable behavior. Architecture cleanliness alone never authorizes a behavior change.

invariants: Exactly one Universal Control remains visible globally.
The retired per-page global shell never mounts UI.
Bottom-right remains behavior-compatible with the current V5 physics.
Corner Anchor keeps one semantic corner, never persisted pixel coordinates.
Enter commits and Escape goes back in every corner.
Favorites remain ordered by stable page_id and work offline.
Organizar páginas remains reachable from the same Universal Control.
Notes and recording remain usable while pages continue to exist behind PAGE HOST.
Moving the closed puck never interrupts an active recording/background transcription.
No candidate gains Current, Human Accepted or Served authority merely by being newer.

phases.name: FREEZE_BASELINE
phases.rule: Record exact served bytes/contracts and do not modify them while extraction begins.

phases.name: COMPATIBILITY_FACADES
phases.rule: Extract narrow APIs whose first implementation calls the exact legacy backend and preserves its storage keys, timing and observable results.

phases.name: SHADOW_PARITY
phases.rule: Run a proposed backend beside the legacy implementation and compare outputs/state without giving the proposal write authority over canonical data.

phases.name: ONE_OWNER_CUTOVER
phases.rule: Move one subsystem only after additive/idempotent migration, reload/offline/browser parity and rollback evidence pass. Never cut over multiple domains in one change.

phases.name: SERVED_PROMOTION
phases.rule: Candidate -> automated contract tests -> representative browser canary -> mobile canary where relevant -> atomic deploy -> live served verification. Promotion is forbidden on any baseline capability loss.

do_not_combine: backend extraction + Corner Anchor physics rewrite
rollback_rule: Until a domain cutover is explicitly verified and promoted, the last served Golden Master and its persistence owner remain authoritative.
